sentences.text: Kunala Prasada Rao , vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on

Author: J. Uma Devi
Bench: J. Uma Devi
 The Hon'Ble Ms. Justice J. Uma Devi
 Criminal Petition No.1235 Of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/A.1 and A.2, seeking to quash the proceedings in F.I.R.No.230 of 2019 of Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 270,273, 188 IPC and Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is brought to the notice of this Court that in batch of Criminal Petitions filed to quash the proceedings registered for the offences under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act are allowed by this Court in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.
The case on hand has also been filed questioning the proceedings in F.I.R registered for the offence of Transportation of banned tobacco products.

Following the order passed in the aforementioned batch of criminal petitions, and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed quashing the proceedings in F.I.R.No.230 of 2019 of Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 270,273, 188 IPC and Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, as against the petitioners/A.1 and A.2.

entities.text: Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall also stand closed in consequence.
